workflow: A traversal iterates a caller-controlled collection using non-owning references to its elements.
Processing an element invokes user-controlled code that reentrantly clears or mutates the collection.
The mutation invalidates the referenced element and may release its backing storage.
The traversal continues using the stale reference, causing a use-after-free and process-terminating memory failure.
summary: Reentrant collection mutation invalidates an active element reference
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches re-entrant mutation invalidating container storage while the original clearing or traversal operation still holds and uses a reference into that storage.
